headline: '50%+1 share' mandatory tender offer system passes National Assembly Political Affairs Committee
summary: A mandatory tender offer system, letting general shareholders sell at a price reflecting the control premium, passed the National Assembly Political Affairs Committee. The offer size is set so the acquirer's post-deal stake becomes 50% plus one share.
why: Mandatory tender offer rules protect minority shareholders in change-of-control deals and affect the cost and structure of acquisitions in Korean listed companies.
